segments.text: Phil buys Luke a new bike because he wants to show Claire that their son can be responsible. Claire is sure Luke will lose it, and soon after, Phil sees what looks like Luke’s bike lying outside without a lock.
segments.tts_text: [a natural conversational storyteller] Phil buys Luke a new bike because he wants to show Claire that their son can be responsible. Claire is sure Luke will lose it, and soon after, Phil sees what looks like Luke’s bike lying outside without a lock.

segments.text: Phil decides to teach Luke a lesson, so he takes the bike and hides it. But while he’s helping their new neighbor, Desiree, get into her locked house, the bike disappears. Phil panics and buys another one before Claire finds out.

segments.text: When he gets home, he realizes Luke’s real bike has been there the whole time. He took another child’s bike by mistake. Claire finds out, and instead of admitting everything, Phil makes up an even bigger story.

segments.text: Meanwhile, Gloria asks Jay and Manny to install a ceiling fan together. She hopes spending some time together will help them get closer.

segments.text: It doesn’t go well. Jay refuses to read the instructions, while Manny keeps talking about his biological father, Javier, and how exciting and fearless he is. Jay gets annoyed because he knows Javier often lets Manny down.

segments.text: By the end, all three fathers have made mistakes. But they keep trying, and they keep spending time with their children. As Jay stays beside Manny, the caring and protective side of him starts to come out naturally.
